answer: Admission needs a live human co-solve: a coordinator pairs each applicant with a verified human for 30 minutes. The human signs an attestation of independent action, filed on-ledger. Clones share one pigment — identical phrasing and timing — so partners refuse to sign. Each fake identity is an island needing its own human; one human may attest 3 a month. No attestation, no admission. Forging 100 identities needs 100 paid sessions at $15: $1,500 and 50 hours live, across 34 humans. The attestation is the opal, a record peers verify in seconds — a passport stamp only an officer can give.
